people.name: Hamor
people.line: A Hivite prince, father of Shechem.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: Founded the city where Dinah was raped

translations.web: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
translations.bsb: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with their swords, took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
translations.kjv: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.
translations.asv: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went forth.
